model: Map notices stayed opaque for 85% of mapOverlayFade and then faded to opacity 0 while scaling to 0.95. The hide timer still removes them. The fade animation is gone, so the last 15% is no longer a transparent overlay on the map.

noise.rule: 15% of 12s, 3s, and 4s, times 60fps. One notice is visible at a time, so these are separate shows, not a sum on one frame. Not a sampled compositor trace.
